scripts.build: pushd lib; bun run build; popd && bun scripts/verify-declarations.ts
scripts.build-site: bun run --filter markdown-to-jsx build && pushd site; bun run build; popd
scripts.bench: pushd benchmarks; bun run bench; popd
scripts.bench:all: pushd benchmarks; bun run bench:all; popd
scripts.bench:jsx: pushd benchmarks; bun run bench:jsx; popd
scripts.bench:html: pushd benchmarks; bun run bench:html; popd
scripts.dev:browser: bun run --filter markdown-to-jsx build && bun run --filter @markdown-to-jsx/browser dev
scripts.test:browser: bun run --filter markdown-to-jsx build && bun run --filter @markdown-to-jsx/browser build && bun run --filter @markdown-to-jsx/browser test
scripts.test:native: bun run --filter markdown-to-jsx build && bun run --filter @markdown-to-jsx/native test
